data.name: Endless Tower Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Endless Tower Survivors is a pure survival challenge where your only goal is simple:

Survive for as long as possible.

Your tower stands alone against endless waves of monsters that grow stronger with every passing minute. There are no safe moments and no final wave — only an ever-growing siege.

Earn gold from fallen enemies, upgrade your defenses, and turn your tower into a devastating war machine capable of destroying entire hordes.
Discover powerful combinations, adapt to the escalating difficulty, and push your survival time further with every attempt.

From overwhelming enemy swarms to unexpected boss encounters, every run tests how long your defenses can truly hold.

How long can your tower survive?

Key Features

Endless Survival
Fight against infinite waves of enemies that grow stronger over time. The longer you survive, the more intense the battle becomes.

Unique Weapons
Build devastating weapon combinations and transform your tower into a powerful defensive machine.

Upgrades
Customize your playstyle with a massive variety of upgrades that drastically change how each run unfolds.

Unique Builds Every Run
Different weapon and upgrade combinations create new strategies and gameplay every time you play.

Boss Encounters
Occasionally powerful bosses appear during the siege. Defeat them to earn special rewards.

Pure Survival Challenge
No scripted ending. No limits. Just your tower against an endless army.

data.short_description: Endless Tower Survivors is a roguelite tower defense survival game where a single tower fights against endless hordes of enemies. Combine weapons and upgrades to create unlimited power tower and survive as long as possible.
